name.zh: 中国远征军入缅与撤往印度
name.en: Chinese Expeditionary Force enters Burma and withdraws to India

description.zh: 示意初稿，待史料校订：远征军自昆明入缅作战，失利后部分撤往印度。
description.en: Illustrative draft pending historical review: the expeditionary force entered Burma from Kunming and, after setbacks, partly withdrew to India.

description.zh: 示意初稿，待史料校订：中国驻印军与盟军自印度利多反攻缅北，1945 年 3 月收复曼德勒。
description.en: Illustrative draft pending historical review: Chinese forces in India and Allied troops counterattacked from Ledo, recovering Mandalay in March 1945.
